Personal 2U CubeSat intended to be the first Malaysian private individual’s satellite in orbit.
Description

KENSAT is Malaysia's first CubeSat mission launched by a private individual (Ken Chan), designed to demonstrate technological capabilities and inspire the next generation of Malaysian space engineers.
Our mission represents a significant milestone in Malaysia's journey into space exploration through private initiatives.
With a focus on accessibility and education, KENSAT aims to capture images of Earth, demonstrate innovative hardware and software solutions, and inspire others to pursue space technology development.
